i.norm: Verifies that two TaiInstants with swapped seconds/nanoAdjustment arguments are not equal, and that a negative nanoAdjustment is normalized: the excess nanos borrow one second, leaving a positive nano-of-second in [0, 999_999_999]. ofTaiSeconds(-1192, -3113): floorDiv(-3113, 1_000_000_000) = -1 → seconds = -1192 + (-1) = -1193 floorMod(-3113, 1_000_000_000) = 999_996_887
Negative nanoAdjustment borrows one whole second, leaving a positive nano-of-second.
